description: This PHP source file contains acceptance test cases for the Issue Module in a SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM derived project. It defines a class IssueModuleCest with multiple test scenarios to verify creation, viewing, editing, duplicating, and deleting issue records within the CRM application. The tests utilize the Codeception testing framework with various step objects to simulate user interactions.

classes.name: IssueModuleCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for the Issue Module covering scenarios like creation, viewing, editing, duplicating, and deleting issue records in the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method to initialize fake data generator and seed for reproducible tests.

methods.name: _after
methods.description: Teardown method, currently empty, called after each test.

methods.description: Test scenario to create and deploy an issue module using the module builder.

methods.description: Test scenario for creating a new issue record with generated fake data.

methods.description: Test scenario to edit an existing issue record from its detail view.
